observations: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show the same stainless steel 3-burner gas cooker from a top-down angle.
The cooker has two burners on the left and one on the right, with black grates over each.
The control knobs are located at the bottom right corner, with three visible knobs.
There is a label on the bottom right with safety and usage instructions, but the text is too small to read clearly.
The surface shows some minor scratches and smudges, especially on the left burner.
The cooker appears to be in used condition, with no visible damage to the body or burners.
No signs of gas leaks or damage to the burners are visible in the photos.
